description: This file implements the certificate verification process in Chromium, including path building, trust store management, revocation checking, and EV certificate handling. It defines classes and functions for internal certificate validation logic used in network security.

classes.name: CertVerifyProcTrustStore
classes.description: Wraps a SystemTrustStore with additional trust anchors and test roots, managing trust store lookups and trust anchor additions.

classes.name: PathBuilderDelegateDataImpl
classes.description: Holds delegate data for path building, including OCSP verification results.

classes.name: PathBuilderDelegateImpl
classes.description: Implements path building delegate logic, including revocation checking policies and EV policy conformance.

classes.name: CertVerifyProcBuiltin
classes.description: Implements the core certificate verification process, including path building, trust store management, and revocation checks.

methods.name: ParseCertificateFromBuffer
methods.description: Parses a certificate from a buffer into a ParsedCertificate object.

methods.name: AddIntermediatesToIssuerSource
methods.description: Adds intermediate certificates from an X509Certificate to an issuer source.

methods.name: AppendPublicKeyHashes
methods.description: Calculates and appends SHA256 hashes of public key info from certificates or paths.

methods.name: MapPathBuilderErrorsToCertStatus
methods.description: Maps path building errors to certificate status flags.

methods.name: CreateVerifiedCertChain
methods.description: Constructs a verified X509Certificate chain from path builder results.

methods.name: TryBuildPath
methods.description: Attempts to build a certificate path with specified parameters.

methods.name: AssignVerifyResult
methods.description: Assigns verification results, including errors and trust info, to the output structure.

methods.name: CanTryAgainWithWeakerDigestPolicy
methods.description: Determines if retrying with weaker signature algorithms might succeed.

methods.name: VerifyInternal
methods.description: Performs internal certificate verification, including path building, trust checks, and revocation.
